## OPERATOR DECISION (2026-08-24) — retain lossless review history; no enforcing gate; reclaim depends on the GC epic

Rulings on D1–D3:

- **D3 (payload slimming) — REJECTED. Keep the lossless v2 payload (story 4e19).** The benefit of
  retaining full historical review information outweighs the storage cost. Review information costs
  **live LLM calls** to generate and is **critical historical data for reviewer tuning, calibration,
  and analysis**. The performance/storage implications are **accepted**. Do not reduce per-finding
  retained material; the "semantic equivalence" AC is satisfied trivially by not slimming.
- **D2 (enforceable budget signal) — observational only.** Consistent with the operator's prior
  ruling (`epidemic-chocolaty-imago`, reaffirmed 2026-08-23) that hard budgets / shrink-only
  ratchets add unacceptable fragility. The read-only `rebar tracker-footprint` measurement already
  shipped is the signal; **no enforcing gate.**
- **D1 (retired-sidecar reclaim) — depends on the new GC epic.** Merge-safe reclaim of retired
  `REVIEW_RESULT` sidecars is a subset of the general retired-event GC, now owned by the promoted
  epic **polite-antivirus-bedbug** ("Remote-anchored retired-event GC + stale-clone override").
  This ticket's reclaim work will run on top of that epic's S1/S2 eligibility check + sweep.

### Net effect on this ticket
The D2/D3 halves are **resolved as accepted-tradeoff** (retain lossless, observe don't enforce).
The only remaining actionable scope is the retired-sidecar reclaim, which is **blocked on** the
bedbug GC epic. Adding a `depends_on` link and narrowing scope accordingly. Active-growth is
already bounded by the operator-only `RETAIN_PER_TICKET = 50` prune (currently reclaims 0 bytes,
as designed). No code touched.
